blocks.text: Replication nucleotides ke aik khaas sequence par khatam hoti hai jise termination site kehte hain. Origin site aur termination site ke darmiyan DNA ka hissa replication unit ya replicon kehlata hai. Termination ke dauran DNA polymerase I RNA primer ko hata kar khaali jagah DNA nucleotides se bhar deta hai; Okazaki fragments ke darmiyan ki khaali jaghein bhi bharta hai. Enzyme DNA ligase lagging strand ke Okazaki fragments ko aapas mein jorta hai.

blocks.title: For Information
blocks.text: Replication mein asal DNA ka aik strand mehfooz (conserve) rehta hai aur daughter strand bilkul naya banta hai. Yaani DNA ki har nayi nasl mein asal DNA molecule ka aadha hissa mehfooz rehta hai.

blocks.alt: Aik replication fork. Aage parental double helix par gyrase aur helicase strands kholta hai. Oopri bazu par DNA polymerase III leading strand ko fork ki taraf musalsal banata hai. Neeche lagging strand fork se door Okazaki fragments ki soorat banta hai; har tukra primase ke banaye RNA primer se shuru hota hai, DNA polymerase III use barhata, DNA ligase jorta aur single-strand binding proteins template khula rakhte hain. Teer replication ki simt dikhate hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 19.11: DNA replication ka amal (kitab ki Figure 19.11 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Labels: DNA Polymerase III (adds new nucleotides), Helicase (breaks H-bonds), Gyrase (prevents super-coiling), Leading strand, Direction of replication, Lagging strand, Okazaki fragments, Primase (makes primer), Primer, DNA Ligase (rejoins strands), Single-strand binding protein (prevents re-joining).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Dono naye strands sirf 5′ se 3′ ki taraf bante hain. Leading strand fork ki taraf musalsal banta hai, is liye aik primer kaafi hai. Lagging strand fork se door chhote tukron (Okazaki fragments) mein banta hai: har tukre ko naya primer chahiye, aur aakhir mein DNA ligase tukron ko jor deta hai.
